name: 多発性内分泌腫瘍症1型

summary.text: A rare inherited cancer syndrome, characterized by the development of multiple neuroendocrine tumors of the parathyroids, gastro-entero-pancreatic tract, and anterior pituitary gland, and less commonly the adrenal cortical gland, thymus and bronchi, with other non-endocrine tumors in some patients.
